gaps: No press coverage of her council race found
Campaign site text does not name the office sought
collection_notes: Hillsboro's June 2026 candidate packet (T1) lists the seats up as Ward 1 Position A (Cristian Salgado), Ward 2 Position A (Kipperlyn Sinclair) and Ward 3 Position A (Olivia Alcaire). A June 23, 2026 city news release instead labels the Ward 2 and Ward 3 seats 'Position B'; the county certification and packet say Position A, so this is a city-side labeling inconsistency. Hillsboro news pages for Salgado's appointment returned client errors. Step 5 searches turned up older (2022 or earlier) Pamplin coverage only, not used. Seat holder per packet is Kipperlyn Sinclair (running for county commission), so incumbent=false. Campaign domain printed in pamphlet; site text describes school board service and did not state the council race, so no items were taken from it.
